entry.title: Philosophical Tetsu: Creative aeroplanes & flying objects by Japanese legendary director Hayao Miyazaki Do y...
entry.content:
Creative aeroplanes & flying objects by Japanese legendary director Hayao Miyazaki

Do you know why Miyazaki loves airplanes so much? Miyazaki's father, Katsuji Miyazaki, who was an aeronautical engineer. During World War II, Katsuji Miyazaki worked as an engineer and director at his brother's firm, Miyazaki Airplane, which manufactured rudders for Japanese fighter planes. Being surrounded by aircraft parts and aviation sketches as a child inspired Hayao Miyazaki to draw planes from a young age.

This is why you'll find ample amount of airplanes & beautiful designs of them in Ghibli movies of Miyazaki.
